headline: NBC Boston reports that an AI-made video of a dancing Rumpelstiltskin-like imp, which many viewers took for a clip from an old film, has become a viral meme set to a Riff Raff song.
score_reason: Restored to the pool score of 3: the story is now read at NBC Boston and confirmed.
importance_line: It shows how an AI clip can fool people into hunting for a film that does not exist and still become a joke millions copy; the total number of views across all versions was not given.
source: NBC Boston, citing Know Your Meme
summary: NBC Boston reports that a clip showing an imp dancing for a frightened woman in a heap of straw, turning the straw into gold and then becoming a prince when she kisses him, was taken by many viewers for a scene from an old fantasy film, such as the 1987 musical 'Rumpelstiltskin'. It was in fact made with AI and posted in August by Tatyana Tereshchenko, who describes herself as an AI artist and filmmaker. Know Your Meme, a website that tracks internet memes, says a TikTok user paired the clip with Riff Raff's song 'Tip Toe Wing In My Jawwdinz' and a joke about dollar-store melatonin dreams, a post that passed 900,000 views; people now swap in other characters and public figures.
notes: Read in full on NBC Boston and on a Know Your Meme guide; the exact date NBC Boston published its report was not shown in the text.
